candidate_pool_policy: All nonzero tv_show_id values airing in the target schedule period.
cold_start_policy: Training interaction popularity restricted to the target candidate pool; target schedule frequency then item id break ties.
join_rule: same channel and positive interval overlap; union overlap per user-airing
repeats_policy: Previously watched programs remain eligible for every method.
threshold_basis: Our 0.80 threshold was fixed before validation and was not tuned. It aligns with the Kaggle Data page's description of target construction; this is not presented as a universal viewing rule defined by Kaggle.
threshold_kaggle_quote: Only TV shows with high screen time (>= 0.8) were taken into account.
tv_show_id_zero_policy: Dropped before the join because zero denotes unlabelled airtime, not an item.
watch_rule: Our operational decision: a program is classified as watched when the union of the user's viewing intervals covers at least 80% of its scheduled duration on the same channel.
